tools.name: eva_search
tools.description: Find earlier chats and wiki page lines (threads, systems, knowledge) by terms. Hits carry refs for eva_show. On a miss, retry with other words, paths or dates.

terms.description: Words; an item with a space is a phrase.

days.description: Days back, 90 by default; 0 for all.

tools.name: eva_show
tools.description: Read a wiki page or section (systems/map, knowledge/map, <thread>#Now, #Timeline, #YYYY-MM-DD, #Heading) or a source ref s:<id>#<line> from eva_search.

ref.description: A ref eva_search printed, or page#section.

tools.name: eva_status
tools.description: This project's memory: thread page and its Now date, pending update, systems, knowledge, hook and update health, what to read next.
